items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: I mean I used to play guitar out on Telegraph Avenue and wish I was Jimi Hendrix, too.

ctx.x: I mean I used to play guitar out on Telegraph Avenue and wish I was Jimi Hendrix, too. But that was another phase of me. And I’m in the middle of all of the riots at Berkeley, and all of the peace movements there, and all of the Black Panther things as well. So Berkeley is a hell of a place. It’s right next to Oakland, but it’s quite different.
Yeah I spent, I was there last August just something at the college actually, and I can imagine that would have been a very fertile and stimulating environment.
